'''Onasi Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] near [[Telos IV]] that was in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The station's security captain discovered a mysterious device that was determined to be a black market listening device, suggesting an imminent attack on the station.
